business_summary: Kunwu Jiuding Investment Holdings CO.,Ltd engages in private equity investment management, technology manufacturing, and real estate development and construction activities in China and internationally. The company was formerly known as Jiangxi Zhongjiang Real Estate Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kunwu Jiuding Investment Holdings CO.,Ltd in December 2015. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Beijing, China. Kunwu Jiuding Investment Holdings CO.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Jiangxi Zhongjiang Group Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Kunwu Jiuding Investment Holdings CO.,Ltd는 중국 및 해외에서 사모 투자 관리, 기술 제조, 부동산 개발 및 건설 활동에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Jiangxi Zhongjiang Real Estate Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2015년 12월에 Kunwu Jiuding Investment Holdings CO.,Ltd로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 1997년에 설립되었으며 중국 베이징에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Kunwu Jiuding Investment Holdings CO.,Ltd는 Jiangxi Zhongjiang Group Co., Ltd.의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
